title: Freightliner Coronado FUPS Bullbar #8
description: Freightliner Coronado hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. Driving light mounts to customer spec. Tow pin mounted to heavy duty steel backing plate, provision for front mudflaps. Contoured main channel. Reversable aluminium Road Train signs. Indicator repeater lights above main channel. Bull bar can be custom built to your specifications.
